mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that increases tamoxifen metabolism, reducing its active metabolite (endoxifen) concentrations and compromising anticancer efficacy.
action: Consider alternative anticonvulsant with minimal CYP3A4 induction (e.g., levetiracetam); if combination necessary, monitor tamoxifen efficacy closely and consider dose optimization with therapeutic drug monitoring.
